notice: Times are local to the library.

programs.title: Storytime
programs.description: Shared stories, songs, and playful vocabulary practice; caregivers attend with children.
activities: An interactive read-aloud, with chances to notice pictures and talk about the story.
Songs, rhymes, and movement that invite children to participate.
Playful vocabulary practice through naming, predicting, and discussing what happens.
programs.preparation: For this demo, no reading ability or supplies are required; caregivers participate alongside children.

programs.title: Tech Team Training Seminars
programs.description: Practice everyday device and software skills at a public computer.

programs.title: Adult Book Club
programs.description: Talk about a selected work and compare reading experiences.

programs.title: Reading Confidence Lab
programs.description: Small-group reading practice with word-building, repeated reading, and discussion. Supplemental practice, not assessment, therapy, or a special-education service.

programs.title: Homework and Study Studio
programs.description: Guided practice with a chosen school task, planning, and source evaluation. No school records or identifying information are needed.

programs.title: 3D Printing: First Design
programs.audience: Ages 8 and up; under-18s with caregiver
programs.description: Makerspace orientation: choose a simple object, understand millimeters, export an STL, and inspect a sliced preview.

programs.title: Tax Preparation Readiness
programs.description: Practice organizing a sample document checklist and finding IRS tax-help resources. This is not a tax-return preparation appointment or a claim of VITA/TCE affiliation.

programs.title: Build and Explore
programs.description: Build with blocks and cardboard, try a simple design challenge, and talk about what worked. Caregivers join in; no 3D printer is used.
